name: Dicyclomine Hydrochloride

fda.text: 5 WARNINGS AND PRECAUTIONS Cardiovascular conditions : worsening of conditions (5.2) Peripheral and central nervous system : heat prostration can occur with drug use (fever and heat stroke due to decreased sweating); drug should be discontinued and supportive measures instituted (5.3) Psychosis and delirium have been…

summary: Warnings for Dicyclomine Hydrochloride include the worsening of heart conditions, reduced sweating that can lead to fever and heat stroke, and mental changes such as confusion or losing touch with reality [3]. A small computer model, not tests on humans, calculated low risk scores of 17 for the liver and 31 for the heart [M]. If extreme overheating occurs from decreased sweating, the drug should be stopped and supportive care provided [3].
